title: Horizontal Stretch of an Inverse-Square Function
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Give an equation for the graph of y = 1 + 1 / x^2 after it is stretched horizontally by a factor of 3.

steps.title: Recall the Horizontal Stretch Rule
steps.explanation: To stretch the graph of y = f(x) horizontally away from the y-axis by a factor of c > 1, replace x with x / c.
steps.why: Replacing x with x/c multiplies every x-coordinate on the graph by c.

steps.title: Substitute x / 3 for x
steps.explanation: With horizontal stretch factor c = 3, replace x in y = 1 + 1/x^2 with x / 3.
steps.why: Horizontal stretching by a factor of 3 replaces x with x/3.

steps.title: Simplify the Reciprocal Square
steps.explanation: Since (x/3)^2 = x^2 / 9, taking the reciprocal gives 9 / x^2, so the stretched equation is y = 1 + 9/x^2.
steps.why: Dividing 1 by x^2 / 9 multiplies by the reciprocal 9 / x^2.
